info.name: Check status of a previous POST

params.name: txn_id
params.description: ID of the transaction, as returned by the `POST`

items.docs: A successful POST to `/absences returns a `txn_id`, which is needed to query the status of the operation

info.name: Inserts or updates one or more absences

items.docs: Absences will allow you to control when your employees stop accumulating a balance in Wagestream, ensuring they only have access to salary that has been earnt.
